visual_rule: Every voiced beat owns one unique full-screen shot whose depicted action matches the narration; no story artwork may be reused.
text_panel_policy: No instructional cards during the story; only a short title and final end card are allowed.

shots.line: High above the sleepy rooftops, three little Star Friends followed a glowing path to the Twinkle Playground.
shots.visual: Three expressive star friends crossing a luminous bridge toward a cloud-and-moon playground at twilight.
shots.motion: Forward camera drift, blinking lights, waving star points.

shots.line: When their feet touched the first cloud, the whole playground shimmered awake.
shots.visual: The three stars landing on a cloud as the playground lights switch on around them.

shots.line: First came the cloud trampoline. Bend down low, then bounce up bright!
shots.visual: One star compressed low on a fluffy trampoline while two friends cheer beside it.

shots.line: Can you make three gentle bounces? One, two, three!
shots.visual: All three stars bouncing at three different heights above the cloud trampoline.
shots.motion: Three-count bounce cycle with light trails.

shots.line: Next, the crescent moon became a silver seesaw. One friend floated up while another dipped down.
shots.visual: Two stars balancing on opposite tips of a crescent-moon seesaw with the third watching the centre.

shots.line: Lean gently left. Now lean gently right. You are balancing with the stars!
shots.visual: The star trio leaning together beside the tilted crescent seesaw, clearly showing left and right body angles.
shots.motion: Left-right sway with soft sparkle trails.

shots.line: A friendly comet curled its glowing tail into the longest slide in the sky.
shots.visual: A smiling comet forming a curved rainbow-light slide while the stars wait excitedly at the top.
shots.motion: Camera follows the luminous curve downward.

shots.line: Reach up tall, then swoop your hands down as the Star Friends zoom along the comet trail!
shots.visual: All three stars swooping down the comet slide with long curved trails and joyful expressions.
shots.motion: Fast curved descent followed by a gentle loop.

shots.line: Across the dark-blue sky, tiny lights joined to make a stepping path.
shots.visual: A dotted constellation pathway appearing one connected light at a time ahead of the stars.
shots.motion: Path lights connect sequentially from foreground to distance.

shots.line: Step, step, pause. Step, step, pause. Follow the sparkling pattern!
shots.visual: The three stars stepping across separate glowing constellation stones in a clear two-steps-and-pause rhythm.
shots.motion: Two travelling steps, one held pose, repeated twice.

shots.line: Bounce, balance, swoop and step! Every light in the playground twinkled with their new dance.
shots.visual: A wide finale showing the cloud trampoline, moon seesaw, comet slide and constellation path active together as the stars dance.
shots.motion: Continuous ensemble choreography and circling camera.

shots.line: Then the playground grew quiet. The Star Friends rested on a soft cloud and took one slow, sleepy breath.
shots.visual: The three tired happy stars curled together on a small cloud while the playground dims behind them.
shots.motion: Slow breathing scale, descending light and camera pullback.

shots.line: The stars waved goodnight, leaving three warm twinkles above the sleeping town.
shots.visual: The star trio waving from high in the sky above peaceful rooftops, each leaving one warm twinkle.
shots.motion: Gentle wave, three final pulses, slow fade.
